key_impacts: Harbor break walls were overtopped and shoreline flooding reached into city streets.
Damage to shoreline homes and public boat docks reported.
Water intake pumps were impacted by large water-level changes.
Up to 0.5 m water-level fluctuations recorded at the Ludington harbor gauge.
About 2 m water-level fluctuations reported along coastline just outside the harbor.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Gauge near Ludington recorded up to 0.5 m; reports of 2 m outside the harbor.
missing_information: Number of damaged homes/docks not specified.
Exact extent of affected coastline beyond Ludington not specified.
